report:
Reviewed the complete gate claim, all four ordinary associated implementation files (review.rs, check.rs, main.rs and xtask/src/main.rs), and all nine ordinary associated tests. No TODO/N/A entries exist. Captured fixture helpers, Cargo aliases, CI workflow and the three explicitly referenced staleness/output_format/decisions claims.

The shared gate composes model, correspondence, specification and review validity. main::check calls the shared library check/check_model and ensure_valid; the Cargo meta alias invokes that binary. check_reviews constructs current inventory, loads saved records and runs review::validate. load_saved enumerates every validation directory rather than only current anchor IDs, checks real directory/summary/input layout, summary identity and schema/policy, and reads valid completed output only when completion metadata exists. Invalid entries become issues, not skipped approvals. review::validate rejects each current anchor's missing/unfinished/invalid/requested-edit output, current-input mismatches and absent test or implementation entries. acceptable uses the same current-version/input/completed-empty-edits conditions. Output deserialization rejects unexpected fields; blank reviewer/report/edit strings are invalid. Semantic report completeness remains the reviewer's responsibility under the referenced output claim, not a property the parser can prove from nonblank text.

Freshness includes the full initial claim/implementation/test inventory and metadata plus reread additional selectors, with exact content comparison. Structural specification coverage is checked before review success can contribute, and the review validator independently requires both association sets. Obsolete IDs from either loaded records or invalid-record issues are compared against the current anchor map and produce an explicit diagnostic naming validations/<id>/ and directing removal for retired rules or reconciliation and fresh review for renames. Neither validate nor record deletes those directories. Missing current records or obsolete-only inventories therefore fail even if all remaining anchors are accepted.

CI/workspace integration is concrete: the captured workflow invokes cargo xtask ci test, whose associated ci_test runs the same sage-meta check before cargo test --all --workspace. The associated repository_docs_model_and_rust_correspond Cargo test calls sage_meta::check(root).ensure_valid(), sharing the exact gate rather than reproducing its rules. Reading/checking loads records and computes diagnostics; only explicit review start/record writes lifecycle/approval state. This review does not assert a fresh CI execution occurred.

Tests: accepted_report_cannot_replace_missing_test_or_implementation_evidence removes each association independently after acceptance and asserts library and CLI failure naming the anchor. checking_is_read_only_and_recording_preserves_obsolete_records asserts checking a missing review creates no validations directory, accepted check leaves all record bytes unchanged, an obsolete record makes the gate fail while both directories remain byte-identical, and rerecording a current anchor leaves obsolete bytes untouched. retired_records_fail_even_when_every_remaining_anchor_passes removes the current claim/evidence, verifies CLI failure with its retired ID/removal guidance and preserved output, then verifies success only after explicit directory removal.

completed_corrupt_records_and_invalid_layout_cannot_pass exercises malformed output, blank fields/edits, extra fields, missing summary/input/output and a nondirectory entry. It asserts both library and CLI failure and identifies the relevant record, invalid-validation category, underlying reason and review skill. unsupported_versions_and_mismatched_identity_cannot_pass independently changes schema, policy and summary anchor and asserts targeted errors. incomplete_output_publication_never_satisfies_the_gate checks output-before-completion metadata, deleted completed output and malformed output cannot pass.

diagnostics_identify_missing_unfinished_stale_and_requested_edit_reviews verifies CLI failure for all four conditions, anchor/skill diagnostics and state-specific reason or stale source path. invalid_ids_and_paths_are_rejected_without_destroying_existing_reports checks invalid/traversing/unknown anchor starts preserve accepted output, and invalid source paths or wrong semantic selectors cannot mutate active saved inputs. The repository Cargo test directly uses the production ensure_valid gate as described above. Fixture helpers create real isolated source/model/claim packages and invoke production APIs/binary; the failure and preservation assertions are explicit in the test bodies.

These tests and source paths account for current and obsolete records, format/version/layout incompleteness, evidence requirements, freshness, decision outcomes, read-only checking and shared integration. No additional source edits or unresolved defect were found. This pass ran review start/read/record and source inspection only, not the behavioral suites or CI. Central suite results are coordinator context rather than independently executed evidence. Dependency capture is complete for this assessment. No requested edits.
